library(lubridate)

Please perform the following operations on the Gapminder dataset:

  • Please use the lubridate::make_date() function to convert year and create a new variable, yeardate.

  • Please use the log10() function to transform gdpPercap and create a new variable, loggdpPercap.

  • Please use the log10() function to transform lifeExp and create a new variable, lifeExp.

gap_new = gapminder %>%
  mutate(
    yeardate = lubridate::make_date(year = year, month = 1, day = 1),
    loggdpPercap = log10(gdpPercap),
    loglifeExp = log10(lifeExp)
  )

Then

  • Please calculate the median gdpPercap for all African countries across all years
gap_new %>%
  filter(continent == "Africa") %>%
  summarise(
    median_gdpPercap = median(gdpPercap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


  • Please calculate the median gdpPercap for all Asian countries across all years.
gap_new %>%
  filter(continent == "Asia") %>%
  summarise(
    median_gdpPercap = median(gdpPercap, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


  • Please calculate the first quartile, median, and third quartile of loggdpPercap for all countries in the Americas, excluding Canada and the United States, across all years.
gap_new %>%
  filter(
    continent == "Americas",
    !country %in% c("Canada", "United States")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    q1_loggdpPercap = quantile(loggdpPercap, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_loggdpPercap = median(loggdpPercap, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_loggdpPercap = quantile(loggdpPercap, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )




pivot UI

#source("pivotUI_tidyverse.R")
source("pivotUI_tidyverse_u.R")

gap_base <- gapminder %>%
  mutate(
    yeardate = lubridate::make_date(year = year, month = 1, day = 1),
    loggdpPercap = log10(gdpPercap),
    loglifeExp = log10(lifeExp),
    continent_chr = as.character(continent)
  )

gap_pivot <- bind_rows(
  gap_base %>%
    mutate(
      continent_all = continent_chr,
      continent_3 = case_when(
        continent_chr == "Africa" ~ "Africa",
        continent_chr == "Asia" ~ "Asia",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      row_type = "original"
    ),


  gap_base %>%
    filter(
      continent_chr == "Americas",
      !country %in% c("United States", "Canada")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      continent_all = "Americas (without US and CA)",
      continent_3 = "Americas (without US and CA)",
      row_type = "duplicate_without_US_CA"
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    continent_all = factor(
      continent_all,
      levels = c(
        "Africa",
        "Asia",
        "Americas",
        "Americas (without US and CA)",
        "Europe",
        "Oceania"
      )
    ),
    continent_3 = factor(
      continent_3,
      levels = c(
        "Africa",
        "Asia",
        "Americas (without US and CA)"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -continent,
    -continent_chr
  )

#gap_pivot |> pivotUI(snapshot_id = "gapminder_hw6")

gap_three <- gap_three <- gap_pivot %>%
  filter(!is.na(continent_3)) %>%
  select(-continent_all) %>%
  droplevels()

gap_three |> pivotUI(snapshot_id = "gapminder_hw6")
